payload.rationale: Deployment recommendations-api configures requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution pod anti-affinity on topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname matching its own selector. Because only a single node (vm-4) is available in the cluster and 2 replicas are required, the second pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-tjq6d cannot be scheduled. Converting the required pod anti-affinity to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution allows the second replica to schedule on vm-4 while still preserving spreading preference across nodes.
